blocks.text:
## Andean culture and the Caribbean coast

Bogotá introduces you to the historic centre of La Candelaria, museums, Bolívar Square and the panorama from Monserrate. In Medellín, the programme combines a classic city tour with Comuna 13, the modern city and a trip to Piedra del Peñol and Guatapé.

The final part of the route takes you to Cartagena. Here you will explore the colonial walls, the Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas and the old centre, then visit the Rosario Islands to relax by the Caribbean Sea.
